budget.formula: 104 snapshots + 3 measured restart sets + IC +256MiB logs, then20% overall margin. Separate10GiB reserve on guest and Windows backing volume.

physics.sampling: regular cell-centered equal-volume lattice with variable masses
physics.native_variant: Gadget4_3d_mixed_hfix; existing mean-mass and periodic-box smoothing-length seed patch retained in both laws
physics.scope: Within-code velocity sensitivity, not a matched grid inflow/outflow comparison. No cooling, magnetic field, gravity or frame tracking.

cadence.policy: Native run.cc rounds each requested time to nearest power-of-two MaxSizeTimestep block, possibly early or late. All native headers unchanged. Exact extra/repeated states require review, never silent filtering.

initial_checks.scope: Initial header t=0 only. Evolved velocity synchronization needs separate review before time-specific velocity diagnostics.
